recipes.title: Veggie Stew
recipes.method: 1. Pre-heat the oven to 200C/3C/gas 5. Place the carrot, leek and tofu in a large bowl. Add the stock and mix well. 2. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well. 3. Place the mixture in a large bowl and cover with a lid. 4. Place the lid on the oven and cook for 40 minutes. 5. Serve with a slaw of your choice

recipes.title: Veggie Pizza

recipes.title: Fried rice
recipes.method:
Prepare the Rice:

If using fresh rice, spread it out on a baking sheet and let it cool completely before using. Cold, day-old rice works best as it is drier and prevents the fried rice from becoming mushy.
Heat the Oil:

In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Cook the Aromatics:

Add the diced onion and cook until it becomes translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Cook the Vegetables:

Add the mixed vegetables to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Scramble the Eggs:

Push the vegetables to one side of the skillet.
Pour the beaten eggs into the empty side and scramble them until fully cooked. Mix the eggs with the vegetables.
Add the Rice:

Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula. Stir-fry everything together.
Season the Rice:

Pour the soy sauce, oyster sauce (if using), and sesame oil over the rice. Mix well to ensure the rice is evenly coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add Protein:

If using cooked protein, add it to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook until everything is heated through.
Finish with Green Onions:

Add the sliced green onions and give the fried rice a final stir.
Serve:

Serve the fried rice hot, garnished with extra green onions if desired.
Enjoy your homemade fried rice!
